technical.summary: CHD shows solid uptrend structure with price above all major MAs and consistent RSI strength, but lacks fresh momentum catalysts and exhibits concerning TEMA/DEMA/Hull divergences that suggest caution on swing entry timing.

fundamental.summary: No insider or institutional signals detected; earnings announcement in 7 days presents elevated volatility risk.

sentiment.summary: Fear-driven market (VIX-equivalent at 30) presents contrarian buy signal; neutral AAII and absent congressional data provide limited confirmation, suggesting cautious entry opportunity.

risk.summary: Elevated VIX at 28.85 creates heightened volatility risk despite normal yield curve and no imminent events; unfavourable conditions for new swing trade entry in defensive sector.

debate.key_bull_argument: Price above all major moving averages with rising RSI across all timeframes and bullish supertrend/ADX confirms solid uptrend structure; fear-driven market at VIX 30 presents contrarian entry opportunity in defensive sector.
debate.key_bear_argument: Earnings announcement in 7 days creates high volatility risk with no insider conviction, Hull/TEMA/DEMA divergences signal deteriorating momentum, and elevated VIX at 28.85 in unfavourable macro environment argues against new swing entry despite technical strength.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical uptrend structure insufficient to overcome earnings announcement in 7 days, deteriorating momentum divergences, elevated VIX environment, and absent smart money conviction.
decision.primary_risk: High earnings volatility risk combined with Hull/TEMA/DEMA breakdown signals and elevated macro uncertainty (VIX 28.85) creates unfavourable risk/reward for swing entry.
